description: The National Geomatics Center of China (NGCC), under the Ministry of Natural Resources, distributes the public version of the national 1:1,000,000 basic geographic information data (2021 edition) free of charge through the National Catalogue Service for Geographic Information (webmap.cn). Contents: nine datasets in 77 standard 1:1M map sheets: hydrography, settlements and facilities, transport (railway and highway lines, transport ancillary facilities as lines and points), pipelines (lines and points), boundaries and administrative regions, relief and soils, vegetation, and geographic names, with layer codes such as LRRL (railways), LRDL (roads) and PIPL (pipelines) and spatial relations and attributes kept. Coverage: the whole land territory of China and main islands with adjacent seas; overall currency 2019; CGCS2000 coordinates and the 1985 national height datum, positional error within 100 to 500 m. Format and access: vector files per map sheet, downloaded after free registration on webmap.cn, which also lists paid or restricted products (larger-scale vector maps, DEMs, orthophotos, aerial and satellite imagery, control points) and the Tianditu map service. Free; licence: the site's service terms apply, and maps made from the data must follow China's map management regulations and pass map review before publication. Caveats: the public version is generalised and not a symbolised map; the terms page was not read in full and the vector format was not checked. Simulation uses: a national base network of railways, roads and pipelines for continental-scale hazard exposure and network flow studies of China. Related records: none yet for Chinese national base data.
